request: move the feed section up, right under the top cards
program_before:
app "Hen House" egg yellow
table collect eggs num 0..2000, broken num 0..200 = 0
table feed bags num 1..50 = 1, cost money
setting flock num = 400 "Birds in the flock"
let eggs_today = sum(collect.eggs today)
topbar collect, "Log eggs"
statcard round(eggs_today * 100 / flock), "percent laying rate, from" eggs_today "eggs", 100
row gap 2
  stat sum(collect.broken today), "broken today"
  stat sum(collect.eggs week), "eggs this week"
  stat round(sum(collect.eggs week) / 12), "dozen this week"
section "Eggs per day", "last 30 days"
  trend days last 30 days, sum(collect.eggs on it)
section "Collecting days", "last 5 weeks"
  heat last 35 days, count(collect on it), 2
section "Feed", "bags this month" sum(feed.bags month)
  row gap 2
    stat sum(feed.cost month), "feed cost"
    stat round(sum(feed.cost month) / max(sum(collect.eggs month), 1) * 100) / 100, "feed cost per egg"
  each feed top 3 as f empty "No feed bought yet. Add a purchase below."
    row gap 1
      f.bags "bags" grow
      f.cost bold
form feed, "Add feed"
list collect today, "No eggs logged today. Log the morning round."
section "Broken eggs", "last 7 days"
  daybars last 7 days, sum(collect.broken on it)
section "Best day this month", "eggs"
  stat max(days month, sum(collect.eggs on it)), "eggs in one day"
section "Dozens to sell", "this week"
  row gap 2
    stat floor(sum(collect.eggs week) / 12), "full dozens"
    stat sum(collect.eggs week) % 12, "loose eggs"
if sum(collect.broken week) * 20 > sum(collect.eggs week)
  "More than 5 percent broke this week. Check the trays." color warn bold
section "Laying rate", "last 7 days"
  each days last 7 days as d
    row gap 2
      dayname(d) grow
      sum(collect.eggs on d) "eggs" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(collect.eggs on d) / flock, 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2

app "School fees" school blue
table payment child pick Ayan|Hira = Ayan, term pick Term_1|Term_2|Term_3 = Term_1, amount money, paid_on date = today, receipt text?
setting yearly_fee money = 240000 "Total fees for the year"
setting due_day num = 5 "Fees due on day of month"
let paid = sum(payment.amount year)
let left = max(yearly_fee - paid, 0)
remind "School fee is due" monthly on 5 at 9:00
topbar payment, "Add payment"
statcard paid, "paid this year of" yearly_fee, yearly_fee
row gap 2
  statcard left, "still to pay"
  statcard count(payment year), "payments made"
section "Per child", "this year"
  each options payment.child as c
    stack gap 0
      row
        c grow
        sum(payment.amount year where child = c) bold
      draw 100, 4
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * sum(payment.amount year where child = c) / max(paid, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Per term"
  share payment year by term, sum(it.amount), it.key
section "Paid per month", "last 6 months"
  bars 1..6, sum(payment.amount month of addmonths(today, it - 6)), monthname(addmonths(today, it - 6))
section "Biggest payment"
  max(payment.amount) big
  "Average payment" round(avg(payment.amount)) faint
section "Months left", "at the current pace"
  if(paid > 0, round(left / (paid / max(month(today), 1))), 0) big
  "months of payments to finish the year" faint
section "Receipts"
  each payment where receipt != "" top 4 as p empty "No receipt numbers saved yet. Add one when you pay."
    row gap 2
      p.receipt grow
      p.amount faint
section "All payments"
  list payment by day, "No payments yet. Add the first fee you pay."
row gap 2
  statcard count(payment week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(payment prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(payment) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(payment year) faint
  "Last one" since(payment) "days ago" faint

app "Sunnah" star mint
table deed name text, when_ pick Morning|Day|Evening|Night = Morning
table did deed ref deed

statcard finished, "of" n "deeds done today", n

  "All deeds done today. May Allah accept." head

  stack card gap 2 tap edit d swipe remove d

  each options deed.when_ as w

    row gap 2

program_before:
app "Scrap Yard" tool teal
table buy item pick Iron|Copper|Paper|Plastic|Aluminium = Iron, kg num 1..2000 = 50 unit "kg", rate money
table sold item pick Iron|Copper|Paper|Plastic|Aluminium = Iron, kg num 1..5000 = 100 unit "kg", rate money
setting capacity num = 3000 "Yard capacity (kg)"
let stock = sum(buy.kg) - sum(sold.kg)
let margin = sum(sold, it.kg * it.rate) - sum(buy, it.kg * it.rate)
topbar buy, "Log purchase"
goal stock, capacity, "kg in the yard", "kg"
row gap 2
  stat sum(buy today, it.kg * it.rate), "bought today"
  stat sum(sold today, it.kg * it.rate), "sold today"
  stat margin, "margin so far"
section "Stock by metal", "bought minus sold"
  each options buy.item as m
    row gap 2
      m bold grow
      sum(buy.kg where item = m) - sum(sold.kg where item = m) "kg" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp((sum(buy.kg where item = m) - sum(sold.kg where item = m)) / max(capacity / 3, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Kilos bought per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, sum(buy.kg on it)
section "Spend by metal", "this month"
  share buy month by item, sum(it, it.kg * it.rate), it.key
section "Sell scrap"
  form sold, "Save sale"
section "Latest sales"
  each sold top 4 as s empty "Nothing sold yet. Record the first load."
    row card gap 2 tap edit s swipe remove s
      stack grow gap 0
        s.item bold
        s.kg "kg at" s.rate faint
      s.kg * s.rate bold
section "Latest purchases"
  list buy top 4, "Nothing bought yet. Log the first purchase."
if stock > capacity
  "The yard is over capacity. Sell something." color warn bold
section "Recent", "tap one to edit it"
  each buy top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.item bold
        x.kg "kg" faint
      x.kg * x.rate bold

program_before:
app "Bug Board" tool purple dark
table bug title text, severity pick Low|Medium|High|Critical = Medium, status pick Open|Fixing|Done = Open, hours num 1..40 = 2 unit "h"
setting budget num = 60 "Sprint hours budget"
state tab pick Open|Fixing|Done = Open
let critical = count(bug where severity = Critical and status != Done)
topbar bug, "Report bug"
statcard critical, "critical bugs still open", count(bug where severity = Critical)
goal sum(bug.hours where status = Done), budget, "hours fixed this sprint", "h"
row gap 1
  each options bug.status as s
    button s count(bug where status = s) fill if(tab = s, accent, soft) grow tap set tab = s
each bug where status = tab sort hours desc as b empty "No bugs in this column. Nice and quiet."
  row card gap 2 tap edit b swipe remove b
    stack grow gap 0
      b.title bold
      b.severity "-" b.hours "h" faint color if(b.severity = Critical, bad, muted)
    if b.status = Open
      button "Start" tap set b.status = Fixing
    if b.status = Fixing
      button "Done" tap set b.status = Done
section "By severity", "all bugs"
  share bug by severity, count(it), it.key
section "Bugs reported per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, count(bug on it)
section "Hours by status", "all bugs"
  share bug by status, sum(it.hours), it.key
section "Hours still to fix", "open and fixing"
  row gap 2
    stat sum(bug.hours where status = Open), "h open"
    stat sum(bug.hours where status = Fixing), "h in progress"
    stat budget - sum(bug.hours where status = Done), "h of budget left"
if sum(bug.hours where status != Done) > budget
  "Open work is more than the sprint budget. Cut scope." color warn bold
section "Done", count(bug where status = Done)
  list bug where status = Done top 5, "Nothing fixed yet. Pick a bug and press Start."
section "Hours per severity", "all bugs"
  each options bug.severity as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(bug.hours where severity = v) "h" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(bug.hours where severity = v) / max(sum(bug.hours), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Longest open bug"
  each bug where status != Done sort hours desc top 1 as b empty "No open bugs."
    row card gap 2
      b.title bold grow
      b.hours "h" bold

      r.flat.name bold grow
      r.amount
      image r.receipt
screen repairs "Repairs" pen
  each repair where done = no as r
    row card tap edit r
      toggle r.done
      r.flat.name r.what grow
  form repair, "Add repair"

app "Shaadi Catering" gift plum
table event client text, date date, guests num 20..2000 = 200, rate money, advance money = 0, kind pick Wedding|Walima|Mehndi|Birthday|Corporate = Wedding
setting heads num = 800 "Guests I can serve a week"
let total = sum(event, it.guests * it.rate)
let balance = sum(event where date >= today, it.guests * it.rate - it.advance)
topbar event, "Book event"
statcard balance, "still to collect from" count(event where date >= today) "events"
row gap 2
  stat count(event where date >= today and date <= today + 7), "events this week"
  stat sum(event.guests where date >= today and date <= today + 7), "guests this week"
  stat sum(event.advance where date >= today), "advance held"
goal sum(event.guests where date >= today and date <= today + 7), heads, "of weekly capacity", "guests"
section "Coming up", "nearest first"
  each event where date >= today sort date top 6 as e empty "No upcoming events. Add the next booking."
    row card gap 2 tap edit e swipe remove e
      stack grow gap 0
        e.client e.kind bold
        e.date "-" e.guests "guests" faint
      stack gap 0 align end
        e.guests * e.rate - e.advance bold
        "balance" tiny faint
section "Events by kind", "all time"
  share event by kind, count(it), it.key
section "Revenue per month", "last 6 months"
  bars days last 6 months, sum(event month of it, it.guests * it.rate), monthname(it)
section "Booked value", "all events"
  stat total, "total booked"
section "Guests per kind", "upcoming"
  each options event.kind as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(event.guests where kind = v and date >= today) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(event.guests where kind = v and date >= today) / max(sum(event.guests where date >= today), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Just added", "tap one to edit it"
  each event top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.client bold
        x.kind x.date faint
      x.guests "guests" bold

app "Special days" gift ocean
table event name text, kind pick Birthday|Anniversary = Birthday, day date, alert date, gift text?, budget money?
state n text = ""
state k pick Birthday|Anniversary = Birthday
state dt date = today
state g text = ""
state b money = 0
field n "Name"
choice k
field dt "Date"
field g "Gift idea"
field b "Budget"
button "Add" tap add event name = n, kind = k, day = dt, alert = dt - 7, gift = g, budget = b then set n = "" then set g = ""
remind "An event is coming in a week" at event.alert
remind "Event today" at event.day
each event sort day as e
  row card gap 1 tap edit e swipe remove e
    stack grow
      e.name bold
      e.kind e.day faint
      e.gift faint
    e.budget
    if e.day < today
      button "Next year" tap set e.day = addmonths(e.day, 12) then set e.alert = addmonths(e.alert, 12)
"Budget for upcoming" sum(event where day >= today, it.budget) faint

app "Hen House" egg yellow
table collect eggs num 0..2000, broken num 0..200 = 0
table feed bags num 1..50 = 1, cost money
setting flock num = 400 "Birds in the flock"

topbar collect, "Log eggs"
statcard round(eggs_today * 100 / flock), "percent laying rate, from" eggs_today "eggs", 100
row gap 2
  stat sum(collect.broken today), "broken today"
  stat sum(collect.eggs week), "eggs this week"
  stat round(sum(collect.eggs week) / 12), "dozen this week"
section "Eggs per day", "last 30 days"
  trend days last 30 days, sum(collect.eggs on it)
section "Collecting days", "last 5 weeks"

  row gap 2

    stat round(sum(feed.cost month) / max(sum(collect.eggs month), 1) * 100) / 100, "feed cost per egg"
  each feed top 3 as f empty "No feed bought yet. Add a purchase below."
    row gap 1
      f.bags "bags" grow
      f.cost bold
form feed, "Add feed"
list collect today, "No eggs logged today. Log the morning round."
section "Broken eggs", "last 7 days"
  daybars last 7 days, sum(collect.broken on it)
section "Best day this month", "eggs"
  stat max(days month, sum(collect.eggs on it)), "eggs in one day"
section "Dozens to sell", "this week"

    stat sum(collect.eggs week) % 12, "loose eggs"
if sum(collect.broken week) * 20 > sum(collect.eggs week)
  "More than 5 percent broke this week. Check the trays." color warn bold
section "Laying rate", "last 7 days"
  each days last 7 days as d
    row gap 2
      dayname(d) grow
      sum(collect.eggs on d) "eggs" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2

table sold item pick Iron|Copper|Paper|Plastic|Aluminium = Iron, kg num 1..5000 = 100 unit "kg", rate money
setting capacity num = 3000 "Yard capacity (kg)"
let stock = sum(buy.kg) - sum(sold.kg)
let margin = sum(sold, it.kg * it.rate) - sum(buy, it.kg * it.rate)
topbar buy, "Log purchase"
goal stock, capacity, "kg in the yard", "kg"
row gap 2
  stat sum(buy today, it.kg * it.rate), "bought today"
  stat sum(sold today, it.kg * it.rate), "sold today"
  stat margin, "margin so far"
section "Stock by metal", "bought minus sold"
  each options buy.item as m
    row gap 2
      m bold grow
      sum(buy.kg where item = m) - sum(sold.kg where item = m) "kg" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp((sum(buy.kg where item = m) - sum(sold.kg where item = m)) / max(capacity / 3, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Kilos bought per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, sum(buy.kg on it)
section "Spend by metal", "this month"
  share buy month by item, sum(it, it.kg * it.rate), it.key
section "Sell scrap"
  form sold, "Save sale"
section "Latest sales"
  each sold top 4 as s empty "Nothing sold yet. Record the first load."
    row card gap 2 tap edit s swipe remove s
      stack grow gap 0
        s.item bold
        s.kg "kg at" s.rate faint
      s.kg * s.rate bold
section "Latest purchases"
  list buy top 4, "Nothing bought yet. Log the first purchase."
if stock > capacity
  "The yard is over capacity. Sell something." color warn bold
section "Recent", "tap one to edit it"
  each buy top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.item bold
        x.kg "kg" faint
      x.kg * x.rate bold

app "Ad Spend" chart yellow
table campaign name text, channel pick Facebook|Google|Instagram|Flyers|WhatsApp = Facebook, spend money, leads num 0..5000 = 0, sales num 0..5000 = 0
setting budget money = 100000 "Monthly ad budget"
let spent = sum(campaign.spend month)
topbar campaign, "Add campaign"
statcard spent, "spent this month of" budget, budget
row gap 2
  stat sum(campaign.leads month), "leads"
  stat sum(campaign.sales month), "sales"
  stat round(spent / max(sum(campaign.leads month), 1)), "cost per lead"
section "Cost per lead", "by channel, this month"
  bars campaign month by channel, round(sum(it.spend) / max(sum(it.leads), 1)), it.key
section "Spend", "by channel"
  share campaign month by channel, sum(it.spend), it.key
section "Leads to sales"
  each options campaign.channel as c
    row gap 2
      c bold grow
      sum(campaign.sales month where channel = c) "of" sum(campaign.leads month where channel = c) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(campaign.sales month where channel = c) / max(sum(campaign.leads month where channel = c), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Spend per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, sum(campaign.spend on it)

  each campaign sort sales desc top 3 as c empty "No campaigns yet. Add the first one."
    row card gap 2 tap edit c swipe remove c
      stack grow gap 0
        c.name bold
        c.channel faint
      c.sales "sales" bold

  "Over the ad budget. Pause the weakest channel." color bad bold
list campaign top 5, "No campaigns yet."

  each campaign top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.name bold

      x.spend bold
